steps.message:
Because the collection changes after loading, expose it as `ObservableCollection<Product>`:

```csharp
public sealed class ProductsViewModel
{
    public ObservableCollection<Product> Products { get; } = [];
}
```

The page and item types both participate in compiled binding:

```xml
<ContentPage xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/dotnet/2021/maui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2009/xaml"
             xmlns:models="clr-namespace:Shop.Models"
             xmlns:vm="clr-namespace:Shop.ViewModels"
             x:Class="Shop.ProductsPage"
             x:DataType="vm:ProductsViewModel">
    <CollectionView ItemsSource="{Binding Products}"
                    ItemsLayout="VerticalList">
        <CollectionView.ItemTemplate>
            <DataTemplate x:DataType="models:Product">
                <Grid Padding="8" ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">
                    <Label Text="{Binding Name}" />
                    <Label Grid.Column="1"
                           Text="{Binding Price, StringFormat='{}{0:C}'}" />
                </Grid>
            </DataTemplate>
        </CollectionView.ItemTemplate>
    </CollectionView>
</ContentPage>
```

`Grid` is the template root; a `ViewCell` must not be used with this control.
